title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in weDevs Happy…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in weDevs Happy Addons for Elementor up to version 3.50.1. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with low privileges to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity impact with potential confidentiality, integrity, and availability consequences. No patch or fix information is currently provided.
